audience: operators and developers who check cluster health and search indices in Elasticsearch

useCases.title: Check cluster health and unassigned shards
useCases.text: Read the cluster health status with its node and shard counts. Then list the nodes with their heap, disk and CPU use.

useCases.title: Compare index sizes and document counts
useCases.text: List the indices with their health, document count and store size. Read the cluster statistics for the totals.

useCases.title: Search logs and count errors by field
useCases.text: Read the field mappings of an index first. Then search it, or run a read-only ES|QL query that counts rows by field.

useCases.title: Count documents that match a condition
useCases.text: Count the documents that match a Query DSL object in one or more indices. Read one document by its index and id.

useCases.title: Review aliases and data streams
useCases.text: List the aliases and the indices they point to. List the data streams with their backing indices and generation.
